IUI should be performed in couples who are young (≤ 35 years), have a BMI of <25 kg/m² and a normal ovarian reserve (FSH <9.4 IU/l), with a good response to gonadotropins (≥2 follicles ≥18 mm in diameter), and a high number of progressively motile sperm (≥50%).

the number of preovulation follicles, FSH and estradiol levels, the ratio of progressive sperm and body mass index should be considered when selecting couples for IUI.
